description: Add or replace the signed-in user's own resume. Explain that Levels.fyi reads it to fill their profile and get consent first. Max 4.5 MB, PDF up to 5 pages. Never paste resume contents elsewhere. If you can read and POST the file, send multipart/form-data to upload.url within 10 minutes: all upload.fields first, then the file as "file". Otherwise share webUploadUrl for the same account. Check parsing with get-profile. REQUIRED arguments: fileType.
name: upload-resume
